intro.label: Introduction
intro.title: Staying Connected to Faith, Wherever You Are
intro.text:
Faith is more than a tradition. It is a connection to our roots, our families and the values passed down through generations. Hindu.international focuses on making that connection easier to maintain by helping people access spiritual services and religious practices according to their situation.

Some people want to follow their religious traditions whether they live near a sacred place or thousands of miles away. Hindu.international provides different puja, ritual and spiritual services so people can choose the services that suit their needs and stay connected to their traditions.

process.label: Our Work Process
process.title: A Simple Process to Stay Connected with Your Faith

steps.title: Choose Your Service
steps.text: Explore our available spiritual services and select the one that suits your needs or your family's religious traditions.

steps.title: Share Your Details
steps.text: Once you select a service, share the necessary details with us. You can tell us about your requirements and preferences so our team can understand your needs and guide you.

steps.title: We Make the Arrangements
steps.text: After receiving your details, our team coordinates the arrangements according to your selected service and the rituals.

steps.title: Stay Connected During the Process
steps.text: We keep you updated about your booking so you can stay connected to your religious traditions, even when you cannot visit a sacred place in person.

leftItems.title: Different Services in One Place
leftItems.text: People want to follow different religious traditions at different times. Hindu.international brings a range of spiritual services together on one platform, making it easier to find spiritual services.

leftItems.title: Respect for Religious Traditions
leftItems.text: Every puja and ritual has its own customs and importance. We understand this and focus on making arrangements with care and devotion.

leftItems.title: Beyond Puja and Festivals
leftItems.text: Religious traditions are also part of family life, remembering ancestors, helping others and serving the community. We bring these aspects of spiritual life together so people can explore services that matter to them.

rightItems.title: For Those Who Cannot Travel
rightItems.text: Visiting a temple or attending a religious event is not always possible. Our virtual services give people another way to take part in certain religious practices when they cannot be there in person.

rightItems.title: Clear Service Details
rightItems.text: We explain each service in simple words so people can understand the details before booking and feel comfortable with their decision.

purpose.label: Our Purpose
purpose.title: Building a Platform for Hindu Traditions

items.title: Keeping Traditions Alive
items.text: Our family traditions have been followed for generations. We want to keep them alive for future generations.

items.title: Bringing People Together
items.text: Faith connects people through shared customs, festivals and religious practices. We want Hindu.international to be a place where people can explore and learn more about these traditions.

items.title: Supporting Community Welfare
items.text: We support our community and spread awareness so people don't have to leave their religious traditions because of difficult situations. We want everyone to feel free to follow their beliefs and make their own choices without pressure.

items.title: Growing for the Future
items.text: We focus on building Hindu.international into a platform that continues to grow with new ideas, useful resources and services related to Hindu traditions and spiritual life.

bottomCta.title: Let Your Spiritual Journey Continue, Wherever You Are
bottomCta.text: Your connection with faith does not have to depend on where you live or how far you are from a sacred place. Explore the possibilities, discover services that suit your needs and stay connected with the traditions that matter to you.

hero.eyebrow: Hinduism · Sanatan Dharma · Freedom of Faith
hero.title:
Hinduism Is Our Heritage.
Our Faith
hero.subtitle: Help Us In Keeping Them Hindus | Protect their faith, preserve their culture and heritage.
hero.text: Hinduism is a living civilisation of spiritual wisdom, sacred traditions, philosophy, and diverse paths to the divine. We stand for preserving Hindu heritage and protecting every person’s freedom to make religious choices without force, fraud, exploitation, or pressure.
hero.imageAlt: A Hindu family watching the evening aarti on the river ghats at sunset

heritage.label: Why Our Roots Matter
heritage.title:
Hinduism Is More Than a Religion.
It Is a Living Heritage.
heritage.text: Hinduism connects generations through Dharma, spiritual knowledge, festivals, sacred texts, temples, family traditions, and a rich philosophical heritage. Preserving Hindu identity means passing this knowledge forward and ensuring that people can practise their faith with dignity and freedom.
heritage.callout:
Protect Hindu heritage through
knowledge, opportunity, dignity, and freedom of choice.
heritage.imageAlt: Hands holding an aarti plate with a lit diya and flowers beside a temple on the river

issue.label: Understanding the Issue
issue.title: What Is Anti-Conversion?
issue.text: Anti-conversion efforts seek to prevent or address religious conversion through force, coercion, fraud, deception, or unlawful inducement. The focus should be on protecting people from exploitation—not preventing anyone from freely choosing or changing their religion.
issue.cardText: When religious decisions are influenced by threats, misleading promises, or exploitation of vulnerability, genuine freedom of conscience can be undermined. This can also cause emotional distress, family conflict, and concerns about cultural continuity.

vulnerability.label: Understanding Vulnerability
vulnerability.title: Why Might People Become Vulnerable to Conversion Pressure?
vulnerability.text: These situations do not mean that every person who converts is pressured. They are circumstances in which exploitation may occur and where appropriate support can make a difference.

items.title: Financial hardship
items.text: Families facing poverty or debt may be especially vulnerable to promises of money or material assistance tied to religious expectations.
items.imageAlt: Worn hands holding a few coins

items.title: Education and healthcare needs
items.text: People seeking schooling, medical care, food, or essential assistance may be told that help is conditional on changing their beliefs.

items.title: Emotional distress and social isolation
items.text: During personal crises, loneliness, or family difficulties, people may seek acceptance, security, and a sense of belonging.
items.imageAlt: A man praying alone at sunset

items.title: Deception, coercion, or misinformation
items.text: Threats, fraudulent claims, or misleading promises can undermine someone’s ability to make a genuinely informed decision.
items.imageAlt: A hooded figure typing in the dark

response.label: Our Response
response.title: How Can We Address Coercive Conversion?

items.title: Education and awareness
items.text: Teach Hindu philosophy, traditions, cultural heritage, and religious rights.

items.title: Healthcare and essentials
items.text: Help families access healthcare, food, and essential services without religious conditions.

items.title: Education and livelihoods
items.text: Expand learning opportunities, practical skills, and financial independence.

items.title: Legal guidance
items.text: Help people facing credible coercion or fraud understand their rights and seek appropriate assistance.

support.label: Be Part of the Change
support.title: Your Support Can Make a Real Difference.
support.text: No family should have to choose between meeting basic needs and practising their religion. Your contribution can help support education, healthcare, food assistance, skills training, cultural awareness, and community development.
support.note: All assistance should be offered with dignity and without making help conditional on religious belief.

list.text: School supplies and educational opportunities for children.
Healthcare access and essential support for vulnerable families.
Hindu heritage education and cultural preservation.

support.imageAlt: A hand placing a coin in a brass offering bowl among marigolds and diyas

respect.label: Freedom, Dignity and Respect
respect.title: Protect Our Faith. Respect Every Person.
respect.text:
We believe Hindu heritage deserves to be understood, preserved, and respected. We encourage people to learn about Hinduism, understand their roots, and make informed choices without fear or pressure.

If a Hindu freely chooses to follow another religion, that personal choice deserves respect. We also ask everyone to discuss Hinduism and Hindu communities honestly and respectfully, without spreading false claims, insults, or hatred. Differences in belief should never become a reason to demean a community.
respect.imageAlt: A woman praying beside the river as the sun sets behind temples

purpose.label: Why We Exist
purpose.title: Our Purpose
purpose.text:
We aim to help devotees who cannot personally attend the sacred event. Distance, age, health, work, family responsibilities or other personal reasons can keep a devotee away from the holy waters — but they should not keep anyone away from its blessings.

Through our service, we perform the holy ritual on your behalf using your photograph, and share the recorded video with you, so that you can still receive the divine blessings and be a part of this sacred moment.
